correctness.rationale: For an arbitrary slice, finite truncation of the l_q dual norm yields a finitely supported norming profile. Daugavet witnesses in the active coordinates give coordinate distances at least (1-eta)(r_gamma+a_gamma); summing p-th powers gives at least 2(1-eta)^p. A slice concentrated in one coordinate gives the matching upper bound by forcing the complementary p-mass to zero. Quantifiers and endpoint exclusions were checked.
